g.text: Start: selected table, interval and guest count.
Authority may be DineFlow or restaurant-side (D-02).
A competing booking may have won since preview.
Payment is not a prerequisite under P-BOOK.
no reservation created; choose another interval/table
no reservation created; correct input / service unavailable
Explain outcome; no booking success is claimed.
End of booking request: confirmed finite reservation or explicit failure.
[Later lifecycle: confirmed visit reaches its booked end (P-BOOK)]
EXPIRED; interval no longer blocks the table.
Atomic exclusion is required. P-BOOK capacity/boundary and confirmation policies are proposed.
